subject: Purchase reference issuance — spend cap mismatch & line-item repair
messages:
From: Maria Olive <maria.olive@olivetech.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ProcureCo Procurement <procureco@procureco.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for purchase reference and spend cap confirmation

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding walkthrough today. We've attached our completed onboarding form and a brief CSV with the initial SKU/line details. The platform team at OliveTech needs a formal purchase reference to complete their internal provisioning and to schedule the deployment.

Two items to flag up front:
- Our expected monthly spend for the pilot is ~USD 48,000; the provisional spend cap your portal shows is USD 35,000. Can you confirm whether we can increase the cap for the pilot window?
- Line 3 in the CSV (SKU: OL-ML-3) was reduced on our side to 40 units but the onboarding form still shows 100 — that mismatch is holding our procurement signoff.

Attachments: OliveTech_onboarding_form.pdf, line_item_snapshot.csv

Appreciate any fast path here — our internal timeline is tight.

Best,
Maria
Director of Ops, OliveTech
email: maria.olive@olivetech.io
phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Maria Olive <maria.olive@olivetech.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for purchase reference and spend cap confirmation

Hi Maria — thanks for sending these. Looping in Monica from Procurement and Ben from Sales to help with the spend cap and the line-item reconciliation.

Quick plan:
- Monica: can procurement provision a temporary purchase reference for OliveTech so they can proceed with the deployment while we reconcile the SKU quantities? If yes, please include the ID and any expiry/limits.
- Ben: please confirm whether the pilot budget is eligible for a one-time pilot uplift or whether we should ask Finance for a cap exception.
- Maria: if you can confirm the intended final quantities for each SKU (the CSV + short note will do), we'll update the onboarding form and re-issue.

If Procurement can only issue a provisional ref tied to the lower cap, we should split the most expensive line into a separate provisional ref to avoid blocking the deployment.

Thanks — Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Maria Olive <maria.olive@olivetech.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for purchase reference and spend cap confirmation

Hi all — I reviewed the attachments. Summary of findings and next steps below.

Summary:
- Onboarding form total (as-submitted): USD 53,120.
- Portal provisional cap: USD 35,000 (auto-applied).
- CSV shows a mismatch: OL-ML-3 quantity mismatch (form: 100, CSV: 40). Correcting to 40 reduces total to USD 39,440 — still above the portal cap.

Proposed actions:
1) Issue a provisional purchase reference PR-20261209-7421 that covers the lower-cap scope (USD 35,000). This will let OliveTech complete provisioning for the majority of SKUs. The PR will expire in 30 days unless a cap amendment is approved.
2) For the delta amount (USD 4,440 after the quantity correction), submit a one-time pilot uplift request to Finance (Laura). If approved, we will: a) either extend the cap on PR-20261209-7421, or b) issue a second short-lived PR for the delta items only (recommended: split OL-ML-5 into PR-20261209-7422).
3) I've attached a cleaned CSV (line_item_snapshot.csv) with corrected quantities and an annotation column for suggested split.

Actions requested:
- Laura: please review the uplift request; if you can approve, indicate preferred path (amend PR vs issue second PR).
- Maria: confirm you accept PR-20261209-7421 for initial provisioning and confirm final quantities on the attached CSV.
- Ben/Rishi: if Sales want to cover any pilot credits or pre-approve the uplift, advise here.

Attachment: line_item_snapshot.csv

Thanks — Monica
Procurement Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Maria Olive <maria.olive@olivetech.io>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for purchase reference and spend cap confirmation

Monica — I reviewed the corrected CSV and the uplift ask. Short answer: we can approve a targeted uplift for the pilot delta, but prefer issuing a second provisional PR for the overage lines to keep the core cap intact.

Decision and instructions:
- Approve issuance of PR-20261209-7421 for USD 35,000 (covers corrected core SKUs).
- Approve a second provisional PR-20261209-7422 limited to the higher-cost line OL-ML-5 (delta USD 4,440). PR-7422 will be flagged as "pilot uplift" and expire in 14 days. Finance will not invoice until final reconciliation post-pilot.
- Require Sales or the customer to acknowledge in writing that PR-7422 is pilot-only and subject to post-pilot reconciliation. That acknowledgement can be the reply to this thread.

Monica — please issue both PRs and update the onboarding form with the PR IDs and per-line allocations. Maria — once you confirm quantities, we'll mark both PRs as active.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
